decisions.decision: Attorneys and firms may claim, verify, correct and edit basic profiles without payment.
Optional paid products may add clearly labeled sponsored visibility, enhanced prominence, lead eligibility and access to case or attorney-review opportunities.
Opportunity charges must be fixed disclosed subscription, advertising, platform or access charges; no percentage of legal fees or outcome-contingent charge.
Payment never verifies identity or credentials, proves specialty relevance, buys organic rank or endorsement, or guarantees work or results.
The v1.7.43 complimentary Founding Profile Pilot is no longer an active launch model.
Initial portals remain Divorce, Estate, and Personal Injury; Personal Injury includes vehicle accidents; Workers Compensation remains separate.
Live payments, sponsored placement, case opportunities, portal imports, automatic writes and deployment remain closed.

Attorneys and authorized firms manage separate portal-specific profile sections centrally; approval is exact-revision and exact-central-source-revision bound; public rendering remains on each micro-portal.
decisions.scope: Divorce Law Aid, Estate Law Aid, and Personal Injury Law Aid
